answer_2.quote: we adopt F1 score used in [citation] as the evaluation metric. Specifically, let W be the ground truth token set, W ′ be the predicted token set, we compute the F1 score by the harmonic mean of precision |W ∩W ′| / |W ′| and recall |W ∩W ′| / |W| .
